create schema private;

grant usage on schema private to authenticated;

create function private.is_suspended(p_user_id uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = ''
as $$
  select coalesce((select suspended from public.accounts where user_id = p_user_id), false)
$$;

create function private.can_share(p_file_id bigint, p_user_id uuid, p_check_edit boolean) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.file_shares
    where file_id = p_file_id and shared_with = p_user_id and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())
    <?php if (p_check_edit) { ?> and can_edit = true <?php } ?>
  )
$$;

alter table public.accounts enable row level security;
alter table public.files enable row level security;

create policy "accounts_select_self"
  on public.accounts

  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

create policy "files_insert_owner"
  on public.files

create policy "files_update_owner"

  with check (owner_id = auth.uid() and not private.is_suspended(auth.uid()));

create policy "files_update_shared_edit"

  with check (owner_id != auth.uid() and not private.is_suspended(auth.uid()) and private.can_share(id, auth.uid(), true));

create policy "files_delete_owner"
